mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that may trigger recession fears, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises and housing starts fall simultaneously, it signals a dual deterioration in labor market health and consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and HOUST < 550, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and rising), further rate hikes compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls below 130,000 thousand for two consecutive months signals weakening labor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 130000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index exceeds 215.0 and unemployment remains above 5.0%, it signals a persistent inflationary environment with weak labor markets, prompting aggressive monetary policy that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 550 thousand units for two consecutive months signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 550, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
